source:
@@U03275@@
I'd never laid eyes on 福玻斯, or 阿瑞斯, or 赫耳墨斯
and all the others—and then,
there before me, I saw him,
and in seeing I saw what men can only
praise as divine.
Born to be a king, in youth
he was glorious to see,
subject to his elder brother,
though also, no less, to the loveliest of women.
Earth will never see his like again,
nor 赫柏 lead him into heaven.
Poets will labor in vain to sing his praises,
and sculptors torture stone to make his image.

@@U03277@@
Let sculptors boast all they like,
no one has ever portrayed him as well as your words.
Having spoken now of the most splendid of men,
tell me of the loveliest of women.

@@U03279@@
What! Female beauty!
Female beauty is nothing,
a rigid, lifeless image!
I reserve my praise for those
whose being is a fountain of joy in life.
Beauty is its own obsession, its own bliss.
Ah, but add to it Grace,
and it becomes irresistible,
charm that escapes the contemplative and
surges to active devotion.
Like 海伦 when I carried her.

@@U03281@@
Carried her?

@@U03283@@
Yes, on this back.

translation:
@@U03275@@
我从未见过福玻斯、阿瑞斯或赫耳墨斯
以及所有其他人——然后，
在我面前，我看到了他，
在看到的过程中我看到了男人只能看到的东西
赞美如神。
年轻时为王而生
他很荣幸见到，
服从于他的哥哥，
但同样，对于最可爱的女人来说也是如此。
地球再也见不到他这样的人了，
赫柏也不能带领他进入天堂。
诗人将徒劳地歌颂他，
雕塑家通过折磨石头来塑造他的形象。

@@U03277@@
让雕塑家尽情夸耀，
没有人能够像你的话那样描绘他。
现在已经谈到了最杰出的人物，
告诉我最可爱的女人。

@@U03279@@
什么！女性之美！
女性美貌无所谓，
一个僵化的、毫无生气的形象！
我保留对那些人的赞扬
他的存在是生命快乐的源泉。
美是它自己的痴迷，它自己的幸福。
啊，但加上格蕾丝，
并且变得不可抗拒，
摆脱沉思的魅力
涌向积极的奉献。
就像我抱着她时的海伦一样。

@@U03281@@
抱着她？

@@U03283@@
是的，在这个背面。
